sources: RIDB campsite catalog for facility 233172 (trip_data/ridb_campsites.json, fetched 2026-10-20)

values.note: recreation.gov 2026 and 2027: standard non-electric site $26/night (peak season 2026-05-22 to 09-26; first-come walk-in season 2026-05-15 to 05-21 same rate). Extra vehicle $8/night. The Forest Service page still lists $22 single / $44 double. Hiawatha West day use $8.

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233172/rates ('Peak Season 2026-05-22 - 2026-09-26: STANDARD NONELECTRIC 26'; same for 2027) + campground notices ('Extra vehicle will be charged an $8 per night fee'), read 2026-10-22

hookups.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233172 (notice: 'There are no electricity, water or sewer hookups at the campground'), read 2026-10-22

sites.source: RIDB campsite catalog for 233172 (fetched 2026-10-20): 33 STANDARD NONELECTRIC sites (20 reservable, 13 not) plus 1 management site; Max Vehicle Length 20-60 ft (two sites 60 ft); Driveway Entry 'Back-In' on every site

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233172 ('Accessible vault toilets and drinking water are provided'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Concessionaire-run (refund notice: 'the campground concessionaire'). 20 sites reservable on recreation.gov, 13 first-come; the opening week (May 15-21 in 2026) is first-come for all. Reserved sites held until noon the day after arrival. Check-in 2 pm, check-out noon.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/233172 ('Some sites are available on a first-come, first-served basis'; rule maxConsecutiveStay 14; notices on holding reservations, check-in/out and the concessionaire) + /rates ('First-come, First-served Season 2026-05-15 - 2026-05-21') + RIDB catalog (20 reservable / 13 not), read 2026-10-22

note: USFS Hiawatha National Forest campground at the south end of Au Train Lake, about 10 miles southwest of Munising; large wooded gravel sites. Boat ramp at the campground's parking area, swimming beach (no lifeguard), and the two-mile Songbird interpretive trail. --Claude
summary: recreation.gov (2026 and 2027 $26 standard non-electric, 14-night max, some FCFS, no hookups, vault toilets + drinking water), RIDB catalog (33 public back-in sites, 20 reservable, max 60 ft) and the new Forest Service page (season May 15 - Sept 30). Added season dates, max stay, pull_through false; site count 37 -> 33 per the catalog; hookups/facilities/booking moved to manual. Note trimmed of site, booking, hookup and length facts. Concessionaire-operated on federal land (ownership federal kept). No current road or campground alerts on the forest page (only Haymeadow Trail and Stonington Quarry); the FS page's 'Site Closed' badge reads as the seasonal close (season ended Sept 30).
